responsibility: Implements the Windows/WinNT-specific Rust frontend target hook initializer by overriding TARGET_RUST_OS_INFO. It supplies the Rust target metadata seen by the frontend for MinGW-style Windows targets, reporting the windows family and OS together with pc vendor and gnu environment strings via rust_add_target_info, then instantiates targetrustm with that hook. This file is the Rust-language OS-identification companion to the broader WinNT target support, not a general Windows ABI or driver configuration file.
